provider: Wayback Machine — Save Page Now 2 (capture API)

free_tier.stated: No storage quota; Retention is effectively permanent.

retention.stated: No storage quota; Retention is effectively permanent

egress.terms: Free, via web.archive.org replay with Range support

tooling: SPN2 REST API (POST https://web.archive.org/save, job_id polling); wrappers palewire/savepagenow, akamhy/waybackpy, overcast07/wayback-machine-spn-scripts
chaining: In practice bounded by concurrency (12 concurrent authenticated).
limits_note: 2GB max resource; 10s connect timeout; 50s capture / 2m total; 12 concurrent captures (authenticated), 6 anonymous; 10 captures per URL per day; redirects max 3; robots-blocked URLs rejected; delay_wb_availability=1 defers visibility ~12h.

identity_cost.detail: Retention is effectively permanent. Live probe now returns 401 'You need to be logged in to use S

reliability_note: Live probe now returns 401 'You need to be logged in to use Save Page Now' for anonymous POST, so the 4k/day anonymous allowance in the 2022 spec is stale; the plain GET /save/<url> path returned 429 on first try.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: 'Max resource size = 2GB', 'Max captures per day for authenticated users = 100k', 'Max concurrent captures = 12'
